# code | property
31 | the ring holds exactly the ready tasks, each one once
32 | at most one task runs; it is `current` and holds 1 to quantum ticks; an idle processor holds none
33 | add, wake, remove, block and exit return the exact code the tracked state implies, and a refused operation changes no task state
34 | first-in first-out: every dispatch picks the task that has been ready the longest, or idles when none is ready
35 | time slice: a tick takes the processor away exactly when the running task has used its whole quantum, and a dispatched task starts with a full quantum
